summary: Material process change on Quinshon Judkins rushing attempts: withdraw the prior 13.5 play-to ceiling. The simple three-source mean is 13.87 and median 13.6, making Over 13.5 at standard juice no longer a defensible 4-5 percentage-point edge. Reclassify Judkins from carry-forward BET to WATCH/conditional: do not bet O13.5 or worse; only reconsider O12.5 at -110 or better after live sportsbook verification and fresh probability calculation. Jahmyr Gibbs O29.5 receiving remains unchanged and price-conditional through -115 after live book confirmation; no duplicate exposure. No new Grok pass and no new official TNF injury designation change.

decisions.reason: Current analyst pages show O7.5 around -111 and one earlier DraftKings quote at +101, but FantasyPros consensus projects 7.1 receptions. Week 1 role was elite (14 targets, 10 catches), yet the projection/price combination does not establish PRIME's required 4-5 percentage-point edge at a verified current sportsbook price.

FantasyPros projects 4.0 receptions and 52.3 receiving yards. The historical/article O4.5 +140 and current analyst O52.5 prices are not enough to establish a robust current edge without verified sportsbook truth; 52.5 is essentially on the consensus projection.

Analyst sources continue to cite O2.5 receptions, but FantasyPros projects 2.1 catches and no independently verified regulated-book price improves the case. Do not bet from article/model enthusiasm alone.

Current public market evidence is around 59.5-60+ at roughly standard juice. StatIQ is bullish at 72.3 yards, but another same-day analyst source prefers Under 59.5 and BettingPros acknowledges the line steamed from roughly 50-55 to 60+. The disagreement plus lost entry value blocks a BET classification.
